**Introducing Arc Magnus (new) and Arc Image 3**

Arc Magnus is part of Altare's new next generation fully trained in-house Arc family. It's powered by our 10th generation foundation model and is the first model from the new Altare AI team

It's quite an impressive model for us. Arc Magnus acheives 56.8 on Humanity's Last Exam / HLE, which is just below Claude Opus 4.8, and 79.5 on Terminal-Bench 2.1

Alongside this, it includes Arc Image 3 for image generation, and soon Arc Video

Arc Image 3 is one of the best image models available, it's much sharper and significantly better at text and small edits than the previous image models, and it's one of the highest quality image models available

It's built into Magnus and will be available as part of the new model launch upon the release of the new Altare AI platform launching in the next few days

Updates are coming to Altare very soon

We're starting with the first batch which will start rolling out to users over the next few hours
- **Plugins, software and mod manager**: Our Console now allows you to easily manage plugins, software (ex. Paper) and mods if you're running a Minecraft Java server
- **New EU/NA locations**: We're deploying several new locations in Europe and the US to replace the former Warsaw location

And in the next few days:
- **Altare X subscription:** If you'd like access to Ryzen 9 5950X/9950X hardware and some extra features, you can subscribe to Altare X for $9.99/mo. Eventually, this will include extra benefits on Altare Cloud and extra quota on Arc Code and Arc Chat too. It's fully optional, we won't ever remove free features
